changes.title: Docs: rules spine, system graph, clock record, notes inbox
changes.scope: Doc-only. Top of DESIGN_NOTES.md gets pillars P1-P5, the Where-facts-live owner table, the section status index, the numbered 8-rule spine (each revisable), the minute/session/epoch cycle text, the clock decision record, the Leverage Chain definition (owner wording kept: interact with in some way, aware in some way, at some point), the 7-primitive system graph with economy hubs, the save-policy decision for the notebook, the INV-1 verdicts, a reserved tellProfile field note, the section 9 amendment (per-NPC tone blips are not a synthesised voice), the past-advisor cameo as a design-note candidate, and the S2-04 passage edits that retire free-text/ONNX wording. Adds notes/inbox.md and the dispositions appendix. Change ids stay out of AGENTS.md.

changes.title: openspec/roadmap.yaml, roadmap:next, parked records
changes.scope: Migrates the roadmap to openspec/roadmap.yaml (ordered array, depends_on, specs_modified, status planned/parked/proposed; archived/active derived from folders) seeded with this v2 plan, plus the npm roadmap:next script and the DAG validity check. Records every parked item with its trigger: onboarding, DPR/antialiasing, silhouette budget, theme roles, later notebook categories, offline self-play tuning, the small classifier spike, compiler-API import scan, Epoch 1 definition of done. Syncs config.yaml roadmap text and marks 05d/05e as having prerequisites.

changes.title: Design-notes skill fix, AGENTS truth rewrite, docs-truth test
changes.scope: Fix .agents/skills/uplift-design-notes so it writes DESIGN_NOTES, notes/inbox.md and roadmap.yaml and never AGENTS.md (planned systems tagged (planned)); rewrite root AGENTS.md to shipped code only (~900 words, no change ids), single-source versions in package.json, drop CVE ids, shrink config.yaml context under 1.5k words. Adds the one docs-truth test in tests/architecture: identifiers and npm scripts resolve, versions match, change ids only in openspec/ and DESIGN_NOTES, status markers resolve to roadmap.yaml, word budgets, numeric facts against code constants.

changes.title: Gate skill G1-G6, spec rules, task-size rule
changes.scope: Create .agents/skills/uplift-review-gates/SKILL.md with the gate briefs moved out of AGENTS.md and config (G1 end-to-end trace, G2 trust boundary, G3 hot-path cost, G4 failure containment, G5 defect ledger, G6 scenario-to-test traceability), additions only. Adds the spec rules: consumer scenarios for persistence/logging/pipeline requirements with call sites in design.md, and a MODIFIED delta for any register finding that contradicts an archived requirement. Replaces the 4-6 task count with the task-size rule (<=3 source files per task, over 8 tasks or 3 layers must justify or split). Optional npm run smoke.

changes.title: Defect ledger with guaranteed removal
changes.scope: Tracked ledger file in the repo: each entry has id, source, severity, fixing change id. The archive step (opsx-archive wrapper script) deletes the entries naming the change being archived. Docs-truth test fails if an entry names an already-archived change or a change absent from roadmap.yaml. Seeded from the register findings not yet fixed.

changes.scope: One guarded write-route helper (Origin allow-list, Sec-Fetch-Site, Content-Type, per-run token, size cap that destroys the stream, realpath containment), explicit server.cors, real http middleware test on 127.0.0.1:0. Spec delta: multi-session-saves bridge scenarios, stage-inspector routes.

changes.scope: Logger rotates the previous session into logs/prev instead of truncating. Spec delta replaces the requirement that the prior session log SHALL be replaced.

changes.title: Hardening 0b: parallel, louder verify
changes.scope: Run format, lint, typecheck, vitest in parallel with buffered one-line PASS/FAIL; keep verify:serial; delete prose-pinning arch tests; pre-commit runs verify. Spec delta replaces the unmeasured under-5-seconds clause with a measured budget.

changes.title: Hardening 1+2: legacy clamp, seed scramble
changes.scope: Clamp legacy mutations to [0,1] with a telemetry note (throw stays in an authoring-time contract test); splitmix32 seed scramble with a golden-vector test. Acceptance lines for the frozen-input and RNG golden-value test gaps.

changes.scope: tests/support makeRegistry, makeWorldState, makeStageBlueprint; split monolithic tests onto them; bridge gets its first tests. Carries the S3-17 test-gap acceptance lines (caps, mid-hop states, dt splits) for the later hx changes.

changes.title: Hardening 3b: freeze-on-write, share-on-read slice store
changes.scope: StateSliceStore freezes on write and shares on read; O(1) append. Spec delta: default-fallback scenario no longer demands a clone. Invariant tests for frozen outputs.

changes.title: Hardening 3c: typed, versioned slice keys
changes.scope: Optional schema/version/migrate on StateSliceKey; plain-JSON guard so Map/Set cannot enter a slice.

changes.scope: WorldStateCodec with snapshotVersion, Zod load, migrations chain, one field list replacing the four copies. Spec delta: save round-trip scenario.

changes.scope: One entity-id pattern check at load and at materialize so a bad id cannot throw inside the render loop; listSlots reports why a slot is unreadable.

changes.title: Hardening 5a: reducer applied/rejected outcomes
changes.scope: Reducers return applied/rejected with a reason; a throw no longer aborts the batch. Touches every reducer, so tasks are kept at <=3 files each.

changes.scope: Split simulationFrozen from command acceptance so pause no longer drops dispatched effects; PlaySession.status recomputed per call. Spec delta: pause scenarios.

changes.scope: One ESLint determinism block for domain, non-scene content and application; ban node:*, require, non-literal import(); close the layer-test blind spots. Spec delta: determinism ban scope.

changes.scope: Refactor only: step per locomotion mode behind a context object so commit, steer and presence can be hosted. Total phase-transition helper, stale phase fields removed. Under the golden run, no behaviour change.
